scope: Independent finite q/k with PSD noncentral second moments: support-aware rank-constrained score MSE, CPU exact/float fixtures and public structural retrieval; no model/GPU/e2e gain

implementation.procedure: Read actual executed exact and float code, sources and card; shape/rank/independence guards
implementation.acceptance: No unsupported inference; correct pseudoinverse lift and reference separation

reference_boundary.procedure: Exact finite enumerations and independent SVD/support identities; misuse cases
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact identities equal, floated differences <=1e-9 scaled, all declared counterexamples discriminate

data_integrity.procedure: Bind full corpus, protocol, executed code, raw inputs/outputs and all IDs
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing raw samples, unique IDs, hashes current

numerical_sanity.procedure: Check PSD/symmetry, ranks, noncentral versus centered, units/finite values
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Actual errors reported, tiny eigenvalues not called zero; no numerical proof claim

measurement_validity.procedure: Only diagnostic CPU times and chars/bytes; no tokenizer/model/GPU timing comparison
measurement_validity.acceptance: N/A for performance; no accuracy or savings claim

reproducibility.procedure: Independent actual small rerun without overwriting canonical raw and logs
reproducibility.acceptance: All scoped results reproducible except elapsed; full relevant checks complete
